subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Use the left arm to bring the upright box to the center of the table with its long edges running left to right, then place the held shoe lengthwise inside the box with its toe on the left.
Place the toy car lengthwise on the box bottom behind the shoe with its front pointing left.
Pack the hammer lengthwise into the free space at the back of the box, with its metal head on the left and handle on the right.

Hold the raised hammer still in the right gripper. With the left gripper, slide the upright box rightward by its left flap until its opening is beneath the hammer, with the long edges aligned left to right.
Lower the hammer in the right gripper straight into the box with its head left and handle right, let it settle on the packed objects, then release and lift both grippers clear.
Pick up the blue toothbrush and place it fully inside the box lengthwise with the narrow white brush head on the left and the blue handle on the right. Release it on a stable surface.
Keep the toothbrush raised above the box. Rotate the closed right wrist clockwise by a half turn so the thin white tip points left and the thick blue end points right before lowering it.

Center both ends of the left-facing toothbrush inside the box. Lower it parallel to the hammer with its white tip inside the left wall, release it on the packed objects, then lift the open right gripper clear.
Keep both grippers fully open. Lift the right gripper clear of the upright packed box, then return both arms to their respective starting poses.
